minutes.headline: Capital planning committee voted by roll call to send its 29-project priority ranking to the town manager.
minutes.summary: The committee reviewed the town manager's revised scoring, heard the Council on Aging chair on senior center parking, and finalized its composite ranking of capital requests. It voted 4-1 not to rate the Flat Hill drainage engineering project, and members made a few re-rankings. A roll call vote then recommended the list to the town manager, and minutes from two earlier meetings were approved.

what_happened.line: The Capital Planning Committee voted by roll call, all five members in favor, to recommend its 29-project priority ranking to the town manager.
The committee voted 4-1 not to rate the Flat Hill drainage engineering and construction project.
Members heard about senior center parking; cost estimates will go to the town manager and select board, possibly as a special town meeting article.
Members adjusted a few rankings, including Ritter building floor covering, and kept plow truck 2 near its existing rank.
The committee will meet again in the new year to approve minutes and review, and will write its own report.

why_it_matters: The ranked list is the committee's advice on which capital requests get funded first, so it shapes which projects reach town meeting and how far limited money stretches.
The senior center parking lot has no complete cost estimate yet, so a possible special town meeting article could ask residents to vote on a project whose price is still unsettled.
